opinions: I believe discussions about leadership and government are valuable opportunities to teach children about citizenship, democracy, and the importance of making informed decisions

When we talk about who should be the next president, I encourage my students to think about the qualities of a good leader—someone who is honest, respectful, listens to others, and cares about helping all people
it’s important for everyone to participate in choosing their leaders
different people may have different opinions, and that’s okay
what matters is that we respect each other’s viewpoints and work together for the common good

I guide them to think critically, learn about the candidates’ ideas
good leaders serve everyone in the community
